name: Shared Stomach
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level cleric/oracle 4, druid 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (crocodile tooth)

EFFECT

Range touch
Targets two living creatures
Duration 1 hour/2 levels
Saving Throw Fortitude negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

For the duration of this spell, the two targets effectively share a single stomach. As long as they remain on the same plane, both targets are satisfied by any food consumed by either, and any potion consumed by one affects the other as well. In addition, any disease or poison ingested by one affects both targets, though they roll individually to resist the effects. The effects of anything consumed can continue after this spell ends.
